legal_context.principle: Factual contents are distinguished from protected expression and collection rights; a license only governs uses within licensed rights.
Scientific tables are not categorically unprotected; originality and reproduced expression matter.
Database protection can depend on substantial investment in obtaining, verification or presentation; content-only normalization does not automatically defeat those rights.

C-203/02, paragraphs 31-35, distinguishes data creation from obtaining pre-existing materials and preserves the separate-investment qualification. Only official indexed excerpts were accessible during this review; the live full-text endpoint returned an access challenge.

limits: Unspecified source terms remain unspecified. Admission under a factual-content assessment is not an author permission, a new CC BY grant, or a declaration that the original source is CC0.
CC0 covers contributor-held transcription/normalization/metadata/arrangement rights only. Existing source and author licenses/attributions remain in each declaration and notice.
No source PDFs, images, workbook containers, original author software or long source prose are admitted by these decisions. Ordinary column/row labels and contributor diagnostic comments remain.
Content/provenance screening is not independent source-value verification. Existing scientific holds, derived/digitized distinctions and uncertainty meanings remain unchanged.

Substantiality has no universal numerical row-count cutoff. Complete collections and historical compilations require case-specific assessment. The three resources named in the collection follow-up are now admitted; the original Campbell integration collection remains held. This is not a blanket exemption for experimental data or numerical compilations.
The two Barker supporting-study datasets are now admitted through a separate study namespace after a bound numerical-content review; original scientific qualifications remain.

Debian may require a different factual-data/database-rights assessment or exclusion. The installed review ledger makes source-declaration admissions and maintainer factual assessments separately identifiable.
